The `Consistency.lean` 289/10 two-dot count is mostly **main being ahead**, not the branch
adding: 451 commits of main refactoring moved declarations out of that file.

## 3. Declaration table (Lean declarations the PR's own change ADDS)

Filtering the three-dot diff for added declaration lines
(`git diff c199efa7...e371f227 -- .../Consistency.lean | grep '^+\(private \|noncomputable \)*\(theorem\|def\|lemma\)'`)
yields exactly **one** line. The other declarations that a naive branch-file-minus-main-file
comparison flags were already present in `Consistency.lean` at the merge base
`b70fc143` (verified by grepping `b70fc143:MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean`,
count 1 for each) — main *removed or relocated* them, the PR did not add them.

| declaration (PR) | on main? | statement | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MIPStarRE.QPBT.tildeM_consistencyDefect_le_deltaG_add_nonencoding` (Consistency.lean:819) | yes — `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SuppliedPointConsistency.lean:34` | **identical after whitespace normalisation** | the PR's only genuinely added declaration; main already has it under the same fully qualified name |

Declarations present on the branch but not in main's `Consistency.lean`, all inherited from
the merge base, with their current home on main:

| name on branch | current location on main | same statement? |
|---|---|---|
| `complementSide`, `placementEquiv`, `place_eq_reindex` (private) | absent under these names; the placement layer was rewritten | superseded by `ProjectiveSetting` API |
| `placedMeasurement` (private def) | `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:257` (`def placedMeasurement`) | same role, public `ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement` |
| `placedMeasurement_effect` (private) | `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:265` (`@[simp] theorem`) | same role, public |
| `placedMeasurement_isProjective` (private) | `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:271` | same role, public |
| `place_finset_sum` (private) | `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points.lean:216` (private) and `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/LineMeasurement/LinePointOverlap.lean:57` (public) | same statement modulo variable naming (`ε`/`epsilon`, `s`/`indices`, `A`/`family`) |
| `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas` (Consistency.lean:887) | **renamed on main** to `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas_ofGlobalPairWitness`, `SuppliedPointConsistency.lean:107` | byte-identical statement body after the name; **and the proof body is identical too** |
| `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas'` (Consistency.lean:937) | `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas'_ofGlobalPairWitness`, `SuppliedPointConsistency.lean:226` | branch version is `sorry` (line 951); main's is proved |
| `tildeObs_selfConsistent` (Consistency.lean:964) | `tildeObs_selfConsistent_ofGlobalPairWitness`, `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/ObservableConsistency.lean:49` | branch version is `sorry` (line 976); main's is proved |

**The decisive fact.** The PR's one real proof — the body of `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas`
at `Consistency.lean:900-924` — is line-for-line the same as main's proof of
`tildeM_consistent_pointMeas_ofGlobalPairWitness` at `SuppliedPointConsistency.lean:120-144`
(same `global_marginal_encoding_consistency`, same
`right_mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect`, same `hm` block, same closing
`nlinarith`). Compared side by side with `git show` on both shas.

**Sorry counts.** `Consistency.lean` at the PR head has 4 `sorry` (lines 760, 808, 951, 976);
at the merge base it had 5 (758, 806, 837, 864, 889). Main's `Consistency.lean` has 2
(649, 697 — `marginalPoly_sub_pointMeas_approx_zero` and `nonencodingMarginalMass_le`, both
also still open on the branch). Main's `SuppliedPointConsistency.lean` and
`ObservableConsistency.lean` contain **zero** `sorry`. So main is strictly ahead: it closed
all three targets, the branch closed one.

## 5. Review state

`gh api repos/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/pulls/533/reviews` lists four marked reviews; the newest,
**5194177472** (2026-09-14T05:24:48Z), carries `<!-- mipstarre-review pr=533 head=e371f227... -->`,

`VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=n/a)`. Three unchecked findings,

| finding | still applies to what would remain? |
|---|---|
| F1 (blocker) `Consistency.lean:887` — `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas` assumes an unconstructed `GlobalPairWitness` while advertised as `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` | **No** — main resolved exactly this by renaming to `..._ofGlobalPairWitness` and composing the witness in `Extraction.Construction` via `exists_globalPairWitness`. Nothing remains to fix. |

| F3 (changes) audit says the proof uses `nonencodingMarginalMass_le` and retains `sorryAx`, contradicting the head proof | **Yes**, and it is now doubly stale: the head proof uses `global_marginal_encoding_consistency`, and main's copy of that proof is sorry-free. |

## 6. Conclusion

**SUPERSEDED.**

Evidence, in order of weight:

1. The PR's single added declaration,
   `tildeM_consistencyDefect_le_deltaG_add_nonencoding`, exists on main at
   `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SuppliedPointConsistency.lean:34` with an identical
   normalised statement.
2. The PR's only real proof work — closing the `sorry` on `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas` —
   is present on main verbatim as the proof of
   `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas_ofGlobalPairWitness`
   (`SuppliedPointConsistency.lean:107-144`), and main additionally proved
   `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas'_ofGlobalPairWitness` and
   `tildeObs_selfConsistent_ofGlobalPairWitness`, which this branch still leaves as `sorry`
   (`Consistency.lean:951`, `:976`). Merging this branch would not reduce proof debt and
   would fight main's rename.
3. Four of the six "recovered helper modules" are byte-identical to main; the other two
   differ only in doc comments and one tactic, with main holding the newer text. No
   blueprint node, no `leanok`, no `docs/` change is unique to this PR.

Unique remainder, total: one 191-line audit file that review 5194177472 marks
non-compliant (F2) and factually wrong about its own proof (F3), plus an 11-line
append-only telemetry entry. Nothing mathematical.

**Most useful next step for the main session:** close PR 533 as superseded by main, and
separately decide issue #518 (`feat(QPBT/Extraction): discharge tildeM_consistent_pointMeas`,
still **open** per `gh api .../issues/518`) — its target is proved on main under the
`_ofGlobalPairWitness` name, so #518 looks completable from main without this branch. If any
record of the 2026-09-12 session is wanted, port only the telemetry entry and a corrected,
metadata-compliant version of the audit; do not refresh the branch (a refresh would conflict
on `Consistency.lean` against 451 commits of placement-layer relocation and the three-target
rename).
